- member_id (string): Member number as issued by the credit union.
- share_type (enum): Product type of the new share.
- nickname (string): Member-facing nickname for the share (letters, digits and spaces).
- initial_deposit (money): Opening cash deposit in USD.

DECLARED OUTPUTS (extract each one):
- confirmation_number (string): Confirmation number issued by the core for the new share. [pending]

TURN 8 of at most 25

1. click link "Sub-Account Maintenance" -> main: /cb/mbr_search.asp "Member Inquiry"
2. fill textbox Member Number with {{member_id}}
3. click button "Search" -> same page, 6 new item(s) appeared
4. click link "View" -> main: /cb/mbr_detail.asp "Member Account Summary"
5. click button "Open Sub-Account" -> main: /cb/subacct_new.asp "Open Sub-Account"
6. select combobox Share Type with {{share_type}}
7. fill textbox Nickname with {{nickname}}
